description: Vibe Patches v1.4.0: Morphe patches for 365Scores and HDO Box - ad removal, analytics removal, tracking permission cleanup, MicroG sign-in and update blocking.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, automatic screen reporting and advertising id collection, and prevents the app from re-enabling them.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes Unity Ads by answering the app's ad plugin locally, so no ad is ever initialized, loaded or displayed.

patches.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising id (AD_ID) and Privacy Sandbox (AdServices) permissions.

patches.name: Block update screen
patches.description: Hides the 'This app is out of date' update screen, new version popup, and Google Play services update prompt.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization and the app's own ad placements, removing banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Removes analytics and tracking (Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work by routing them to MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and a Google account added in it.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks 365Score premium/pro features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds).

release_notes:
## 365Scores
- **GmsCore support is now ON by default** - Google Sign-In works against MicroG RE with no extra toggles. Requires MicroG RE (`app.revanced.android.gms`) with a Google account added in it.
- Automatically pulls in **Spoof signature** (original Play certificate) for Firebase / API-key checks.
- Hardened patch: unavailable on MOUNT installs, required splash fingerprint, verified GmsCore check injection.
- Smoke tests now cover the rewritten sign-in action/package and the spoofed certificate.

## HDO Box (new)
- **Remove ads** - neutralises the Unity Ads plugin.
- **Disable analytics** - disables Firebase Analytics collection and blocks re-enabling it.
- **Remove tracking permissions** - removes AD_ID and Privacy Sandbox (AdServices) permissions.

> HDO premium is validated server-side and cannot be unlocked client-side; these patches only remove ads and tracking.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xtalos/vibe-patches/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0
